entries.title: John 12:1
segments: Six days before the Passover Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead, was living.

entries.title: John 12:2
segments: There a supper was given in honor at which Martha waited, while Lazarus was one of those present at the table.

entries.title: John 12:3
segments: So Mary took a pound of choice spikenard perfume of great value, and anointed the feet of Jesus with it, and then wiped them with her hair. The whole house was filled with the scent of the perfume.

entries.title: John 12:4
segments: One of the disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was about to betray Jesus, asked:

entries.title: John 12:5
segments: "Why was not this perfume sold for thirty pounds, and the money given to poor people?"

entries.title: John 12:6
segments: He said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and, being in charge of the purse, used to take what was put in it.

entries.title: John 12:7
segments: "Let her alone," said Jesus, "that she may keep it till the day when my body is being prepared for burial.

entries.title: John 12:8
segments: The poor you always have with you, but you will not always have me."

entries.title: John 12:9
segments: Now great numbers of the Jews found out that Jesus was at Bethany; and they came there, not solely on his account, but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

entries.title: John 12:10
segments: The Chief Priests, however, plotted to put Lazarus, as well as Jesus, to death,

entries.title: John 12:11
segments: Because it was owing to him that many of the Jews had left them, and were becoming believers in Jesus.

entries.title: John 12:12
segments: On the following day great numbers of people who had come to the Festival, hearing that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, took palm-branches,

entries.title: John 12:13
segments: And went out to meet him, shouting as they went: "'God save Him! Blessed is He who Comes in the name of the Lord'--The King of Israel!"

entries.title: John 12:14
segments: Having found a young ass, Jesus seated himself on it, in accordance with the passage of Scripture--

entries.title: John 12:15
segments: 'Fear not, Daughter of Zion; Behold, thy King is coming to thee, Sitting on the foal of an ass.'

entries.title: John 12:16
segments: His disciples did not understand all this at first; but, when Jesus had been exalted, then they remembered that these things had been said of him in Scripture, and that they had done these things for him.

entries.title: John 12:17
segments: Meanwhile the people who were with him, when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead, were telling what they had seen.

entries.title: John 12:18
segments: This, indeed, was why the crowd met him--because people had heard that he had given this sign of his mission.

entries.title: John 12:19
segments: So the Pharisees said to one another: "You see that you are gaining nothing! Why, all the world has run after him!"

entries.title: John 12:20
segments: Among those who were going up to worship at the Festival were some Greeks,

entries.title: John 12:21
segments: Who went to Philip of Bethsaida in Galilee, and said: "Sir, we wish to see Jesus."

entries.title: John 12:22
segments: Philip went and told Andrew, and then together they went and told Jesus.

entries.title: John 12:23
segments: This was his reply--"The time has come for the Son of Man to be exalted.

entries.title: John 12:24
segments: In truth I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains solitary; but, if it dies, it becomes fruitful.

entries.title: John 12:25
segments: He who loves his life loses it; while he who hates his life in the present world shall preserve it for Immortal Life.

entries.title: John 12:26
segments: If a man is ready to serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there my servant shall be also. If a man is ready to serve me, my Father will honor him.

entries.title: John 12:27
segments: Now I am distressed at heart and what can I say? Father, bring me safe through this hour--yet it was for this very reason that I came to this hour--

entries.title: John 12:28
segments: Father, honor thine own name." At this there came a voice from Heaven, which said: "I have already honored it, and I will honor it again."

entries.title: John 12:29
segments: The crowd of bystanders, who heard the sound, said that it was thundering. Others said: "An angel has been speaking to him."

entries.title: John 12:30
segments: "It was not for my sake that the voice came," said Jesus, "but for yours.

entries.title: John 12:31
segments: Now this world is on its trial. Now the Spirit that is ruling this world shall be driven out;

entries.title: John 12:32
segments: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, shall draw all men to myself."

entries.title: John 12:33
segments: By these words he indicated what death he was destined to die.

entries.title: John 12:34
segments: "We," replied the people, "have learned from the Law that the 'Christ is to remain for ever'; how is it, then, that you say that the Son of Man must be 'lifted up' Who is this 'Son of Man'?"

entries.title: John 12:35
segments: "Only a little while longer," answered Jesus, "will you have the Light among you. Travel on while you have the Light, so that darkness may not overtake you; he who travels in the darkness does not know where he is going.

entries.title: John 12:36
segments: While you still have the Light, believe in the Light, that you may be 'Sons of Light.'" After he had said this, Jesus went away, and hid himself from them.

entries.title: John 12:37
segments: But, though Jesus had given so many signs of his mission before their eyes, they still did not believe in him,

entries.title: John 12:38
segments: In fulfillment of the words of the Prophet Isaiah, where he says--'Lord, who has believed our teaching? And to whom has the might of the Lord been revealed?'

entries.title: John 12:39
segments: The reason why they were unable to believe is given by Isaiah elsewhere, in these words--

entries.title: John 12:40
segments: 'He has blinded their eyes, and blunted their mind, so that they should not see with their eyes, and perceive with their mind, and turn--And I should heal them.'

entries.title: John 12:41
segments: Isaiah said this, because he saw Christ's glory; and it was of him that he spoke.

entries.title: John 12:42
segments: Yet for all this, even among the leading men there were many who came to believe in Jesus; but, on account of the Pharisees, they did not acknowledge it, for fear that they should be expelled from their Synagogues;

entries.title: John 12:43
segments: For they valued honor from men more than honor from God.

entries.title: John 12:44
segments: But Jesus had proclaimed: "He who believes in me believes, not in me, but in him who sent me;

entries.title: John 12:45
segments: And he who sees me sees him who sent me.

entries.title: John 12:46
segments: I have come as a Light into the world, that no one who believes in me should remain in the darkness.

entries.title: John 12:47
segments: When any one hears my teaching and pays no heed to it, I am not his judge; for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

entries.title: John 12:48
segments: He who rejects me, and disregards my teaching, has a judge already--the very Message which I have delivered will itself be his judge at the Last Day.

entries.title: John 12:49
segments: For I have not delivered it on my own authority; but the Father, who sent me, has himself given me his command as to what I should say, and what message I should deliver.

entries.title: John 12:50
segments: And I know that Immortal Life lies in keeping his command. Therefore, whatever I say, I say only what the Father has taught me."
